column1: 与|yu3|with; and|Notice the long top line and the lower curved stroke in 与.|与此同时~at the same time~妈妈在做饭，与此同时，我们在收拾桌子。~Mum is cooking; at the same time, we are tidying the table.|与其~rather than~与其等雨停，不如先在屋里看书。~Rather than wait for the rain to stop, we can read indoors first.
也|ye3|also; too|Follow the bottom curved stroke of 也 as it rises on the right.|也许~perhaps~也许小猫正在屋里睡觉。~Perhaps the kitten is sleeping indoors.|也好~also fine~先画一棵树也好。~Drawing a tree first is also fine.
都|dou1|all; both|Find the upright right-hand 阝 in 都.|都是~all are~这些都是我们画的花。~These are all flowers we drew.|都要~all want; all need~小朋友们都要洗手。~All the children need to wash their hands.

就|jiu4|then; immediately|Notice the small 京 shape on the left of 就.|就是~is exactly~这就是我们要找的书。~This is exactly the book we are looking for.|就要~about to~天就要黑了，我们回家吧。~It is about to get dark; let us go home.

才|cai2|only then; ability|Notice the slanting stroke crossing the upright hook in 才.|刚才~just now~刚才我们在树下看书。~We were reading under the tree just now.|才能~ability~每个人都有不同的才能。~Everyone has different abilities.

又|you4|again; also|Compare the two crossing strokes of 又 with a single straight line.|又是~is again~今天又是一个晴天。~Today is another sunny day.|又要~need to again~小树的土干了，又要浇水了。~The little tree's soil is dry; it needs watering again.

还|hai2|still; also|Follow the long bottom stroke of 辶 beneath 不 in 还.|还有~there is also; still have~盒子里还有一支铅笔。~There is still a pencil in the box.|还是~or; still~你想画小猫还是小狗？~Would you like to draw a kitten or a puppy?
很|hen3|very|Find the narrow 彳 on the left of 很.|很好~very good~你把书本整理得很好。~You have arranged the books very well.|很多~many; much~花园里有很多小花。~There are many little flowers in the garden.

更|geng4|more; even more|Notice the broad crossing strokes below the box-like middle of 更.|更加~even more~浇水后，小草更加精神了。~After watering, the grass looks even more lively.|更好~better~把椅子摆齐会更好。~It would be better to line up the chairs.
最|zui4|most|Notice 日 above the busy lower part of 最.|最好~best; had better~下雨时最好带上雨伞。~It is best to bring an umbrella when it rains.|最后~last; finally~最后，我们一起把桌子收拾好。~Finally, we tidy the table together.

每|mei3|every; each|Find the two small dots inside the lower part of 每.|每天~every day~我每天看看小花的土干不干。~Every day, I check whether the little flower's soil is dry.|每次~every time~每次看完书，我都把它放回书架。~Every time I finish a book, I put it back on the shelf.

各|ge4|each; various|Find 口 under the crossing top strokes of 各.|各自~each on their own~我们各自选了一张彩纸。~We each choose a sheet of coloured paper.|各地~various places~书里介绍了各地的桥。~The book introduces bridges in various places.

个|ge4|general counting word|Notice the single upright stroke beneath the two spreading strokes in 个.|个子~height; stature~这棵小树的个子比昨天高了。~This little tree looks taller than yesterday.|个人~individual; personal~我们尊重每个人的选择。~We respect each person's choice.

只|zhi3|only; just|Find 口 above the two spreading bottom strokes of 只.|只有~only have; only~盒子里只有一块蓝色积木。~There is only one blue block in the box.|只是~only; just~小猫只是想找一个暖和的地方。~The kitten only wants to find a warm place.
些|xie1|some; a few|Find the two horizontal strokes at the bottom of 些.|一些~some~我们捡起一些落叶做拼贴。~We collect some fallen leaves for a collage.|这些~these~这些小石头是圆圆的。~These little stones are round.

从|cong2|from; follow|Compare the two 人 shapes side by side in 从.|从前~long ago~从前，村里有一座小木桥。~Long ago, there was a little wooden bridge in the village.|从来~ever; always~这只小狗从来不抢小猫的食物。~This little dog never takes the kitten's food.
到|dao4|arrive; reach|Find the narrow 刂 on the right of 到.|到达~arrive~我们终于到达了公园。~We finally arrive at the park.|看到~see~我看到窗边有一只小鸟。~I see a little bird by the window.

向|xiang4|towards; direction|Notice 口 inside the surrounding strokes of 向.|方向~direction~地图上的箭头指明方向。~The arrow on the map shows the direction.|向前~forwards~小鸭在水里慢慢向前游。~The duckling slowly swims forwards.

对|dui4|correct; towards; pair|Find 又 beside 寸 in 对.|对面~opposite side~桥的对面有一棵大树。~There is a large tree on the other side of the bridge.|对手~opponent~比赛后，我和对手握了握手。~After the match, my opponent and I shake hands.

把|ba3|hold; object-handling word|Notice 扌 on the left of 把.|把手~handle~这个篮子的把手很结实。~The handle of this basket is sturdy.|一把~one handful; one of a handled object~桌上放着一把小尺子。~There is a small ruler on the table.

被|bei4|quilt; passive marker|Find 衤 on the left of 被; it has a small dot.|被子~quilt~睡觉前，我把被子铺好。~Before bed, I spread out my quilt.|棉被~cotton quilt~冬天，我们盖上暖和的棉被。~In winter, we cover ourselves with warm cotton quilts.
让|rang4|let; yield|Find 讠 beside 上 in 让.|让开~move aside~小猫从门边让开了。~The kitten moves aside from the doorway.|让步~give way; compromise~两个朋友互相让步，选好了游戏。~The two friends compromise and choose a game.
给|gei3|give; for|Find the thread-shaped 纟 on the left of 给.|给你~give to you; for you~这张卡片是给你的。~This card is for you.|送给~give as a present~我把纸花送给朋友。~I give the paper flower to my friend.

用|yong4|use|Notice the upright stroke dividing the inside of 用.|有用~useful~这条小绳子很有用。~This little piece of string is useful.|用心~with care; attentive~我用心把卡片上的字写好。~I carefully write the characters on the card.
拿|na2|take; hold|Find 手 beneath 合 in 拿.|拿起~pick up~我拿起铅笔画了一朵花。~I pick up a pencil and draw a flower.|拿手~skilled at~折纸是姐姐的拿手本领。~Paper folding is one of my older sister's skills.
放|fang4|put; release|Find 方 beside 攵 in 放.|放下~put down~小朋友轻轻放下水杯。~The child gently puts down the drinking cup.|放学~finish school~放学后，我们一起走回家。~After school, we walk home together.

找|zhao3|look for|Find 扌 beside the crossing strokes of 戈 in 找.|寻找~search for~我们在草地旁寻找小球。~We look for the little ball beside the grass.|找出~find; identify~请找出图里的一只小鸟。~Please find a little bird in the picture.

来|lai2|come|Notice the small strokes spreading beside the upright middle of 来.|来到~come to; arrive at~我们来到公园门口。~We arrive at the park entrance.|未来~future~我想在未来种出更多的花。~I hope to grow more flowers in the future.
去|qu4|go; leave|Find 土 above 厶 in 去.|过去~the past; go past~奶奶讲起过去的故事。~Grandma tells stories about the past.|出去~go out~雨停了，我们出去走走。~The rain has stopped; we go out for a walk.
回|hui2|return|Compare the small inner square and large outer square in 回.|回家~go home~天黑前，我们回家吃饭。~Before dark, we go home to eat.|回答~answer~老师听了我的回答，点了点头。~The teacher listens to my answer and nods.

进|jin4|enter; advance|Find 井 above the long bottom stroke of 辶 in 进.|进来~come in~下雨了，请进来坐吧。~It is raining; please come in and sit down.|前进~move forwards~小队沿着小路慢慢前进。~The group slowly moves forwards along the path.

出|chu1|go out; appear|Notice the two mountain-like shapes sharing an upright in 出.|出来~come out~小猫从纸箱里出来了。~The kitten comes out of the cardboard box.|出发~set off~吃完早饭，我们就出发。~After breakfast, we set off.
入|ru4|enter|Compare the two slanting strokes of 入 with 人.|入口~entrance~公园的入口有一张地图。~There is a map at the park entrance.|加入~join~新朋友加入了我们的游戏。~A new friend joins our game.

开|kai1|open|Notice the two upright strokes crossing the long horizontal in 开.|开门~open the door~我先敲门，再请大人开门。~I knock first, then ask an adult to open the door.|开心~happy~朋友收到了卡片，很开心。~My friend is happy to receive the card.
关|guan1|close; shut|Find the two small top strokes above 天 in 关.|关门~close the door~出去以后，请轻轻关门。~After going out, please close the door gently.|开关~switch~台灯的开关在底座上。~The lamp's switch is on its base.
坐|zuo4|sit|Find two small 人 shapes above 土 in 坐.|坐下~sit down~我们坐下来看一本故事书。~We sit down to read a storybook.|坐车~travel by vehicle~我和大人一起坐车去公园。~I travel to the park with an adult.
站|zhan4|stand; station|Find 立 beside 占 in 站.|站立~stand~小鸟站立在树枝上。~The little bird stands on a branch.|车站~station~我们在车站等车。~We wait for the bus at the station.
跳|tiao4|jump|Find 足 at the left of 跳.|跳绳~skip with a rope~姐姐在院子里跳绳。~My older sister skips in the yard.|跳高~high jump~体育课上，我们练习跳高。~In PE class, we practise the high jump.
游|you2|swim; travel|Find the three water dots 氵 on the left of 游.|游泳~swim~小鸭在池塘里游泳。~The duckling swims in the pond.|游戏~game~我们选了一个大家都喜欢的游戏。~We choose a game everyone likes.

爬|pa2|climb; crawl|Notice 爪 beside 巴 in 爬.|爬山~climb a hill~天气好的时候，我们和大人一起爬山。~When the weather is good, we climb a hill with adults.|爬行~crawl~小乌龟在草地上慢慢爬行。~The little turtle slowly crawls across the grass.

飞|fei1|fly|Notice the long bent stroke and the two small strokes of 飞.|飞机~aeroplane~我们看见一架飞机飞过。~We see an aeroplane fly past.|飞行~fly; flight~小鸟展开翅膀开始飞行。~The little bird spreads its wings and starts to fly.
唱|chang4|sing|Find 口 beside the two 日 shapes in 唱.|唱歌~sing a song~我们在树下唱歌。~We sing under the tree.|合唱~sing together; choir~班里的合唱开始了。~The class choir begins to sing.
说|shuo1|say; speak|Find 讠 on the left of 说.|说话~speak~图书馆里，说话的声音要轻。~In the library, we should speak quietly.|说明~explain; instructions~老师说明了游戏的玩法。~The teacher explains how to play the game.
叫|jiao4|call; shout|Find 口 on the left of 叫.|叫声~call; cry~窗外传来小鸟的叫声。~We hear a bird's call outside the window.|叫好~cheer; applaud~表演结束，大家拍手叫好。~After the performance, everyone claps and cheers.
问|wen4|ask|Find 口 inside 门 in 问.|问题~question~我想问老师一个问题。~I want to ask the teacher a question.|问好~say hello~见到邻居，我们先问好。~When we meet a neighbour, we say hello first.

答|da2|answer|Find the bamboo top ⺮ above 合 in 答.|回答~answer~我举手回答老师的问题。~I raise my hand to answer the teacher's question.|答案~answer; solution~我们认真看图，找到了答案。~We look carefully at the picture and find the answer.
想|xiang3|think; want|Find 心 below 相 in 想.|想象~imagine~我想象小鸟飞过蓝天的样子。~I imagine the little bird flying across the blue sky.|想念~miss; think of fondly~我给想念的朋友写了一张卡片。~I write a card to a friend I miss.
知|zhi1|know|Find 矢 beside 口 in 知.|知道~know~我知道这条小路通向公园。~I know this path leads to the park.|知识~knowledge~我们从书里学到了新的知识。~We learn new things from the book.
认|ren4|recognise|Find 讠 beside 人 in 认.|认识~know; recognise~我认识书上的这个字。~I recognise this character in the book.|认真~careful; serious~我们认真把纸船折好。~We carefully fold the paper boat.
学|xue2|learn; study|Notice 子 under the roof-like middle of 学.|学习~learn; study~我们一起学习两个新字。~We learn two new characters together.|学校~school~学校的花园里有一棵大树。~There is a large tree in the school garden.

习|xi2|practise; learn|Notice the small inner strokes inside the outer hook of 习.|练习~practise~我每天练习折纸。~I practise paper folding every day.|学习~learn; study~学习以后，我们把书本收好。~After studying, we put the books away.
做|zuo4|do; make|Notice 亻 on the left of 做.|做饭~cook a meal~大人在厨房里做饭。~An adult cooks in the kitchen.|做法~way of doing; method~老师演示了纸船的做法。~The teacher shows us how to make the paper boat.
作|zuo4|make; work|Find 亻 beside 乍 in 作.|作业~homework~我做完作业，就把本子收好。~I finish my homework and put the notebook away.|合作~cooperate~我们合作搭好了一座积木桥。~We work together to build a block bridge.
玩|wan2|play|Find 王 beside 元 in 玩.|玩具~toy~玩过以后，我们把玩具放回原处。~After playing, we put the toys back.|玩耍~play~小狗在院子里玩耍。~The puppy plays in the yard.
爱|ai4|love; care for|Notice 爫 at the top and 友 at the bottom of 爱.|可爱~cute; lovely~这只小兔很可爱。~This little rabbit is lovely.|爱护~take care of~我们爱护公园里的花草。~We take care of the park's plants.
喜|xi3|like; joy|Find 口 at the bottom of 喜.|喜欢~like~我喜欢在窗边看书。~I like reading beside the window.|欢喜~glad; delighted~小猫找到垫子，满心欢喜。~The kitten is delighted to find its cushion.
欢|huan1|happy; welcome|Find 又 beside 欠 in 欢.|欢迎~welcome~我们欢迎新朋友加入游戏。~We welcome a new friend to the game.|欢乐~joy; happy~院子里传来欢乐的笑声。~Happy laughter comes from the yard.
帮|bang1|help|Find 巾 at the bottom of 帮.|帮助~help~我帮助朋友收拾书包。~I help my friend pack a school bag.|帮忙~lend a hand~小猫的垫子湿了，我来帮忙。~The kitten's cushion is wet; I come to help.
助|zhu4|help|Find 且 beside 力 in 助.|帮助~help~遇到困难时，我们可以请求帮助。~When we have difficulties, we can ask for help.|助手~helper; assistant~今天我是老师的小助手。~Today I am the teacher's little helper.
请|qing3|please; invite|Find 讠 beside 青 in 请.|请问~excuse me; may I ask~请问，图书馆在哪里？~Excuse me, where is the library?|邀请~invite~我邀请朋友一起画画。~I invite my friend to draw with me.
谢|xie4|thank|Find 讠 beside 射 in 谢.|谢谢~thank you~收到卡片以后，我说谢谢。~After receiving the card, I say thank you.|感谢~thank; be grateful~我感谢朋友帮我找到了铅笔。~I thank my friend for helping me find my pencil.

再|zai4|again|Notice the long middle horizontal stroke extending on both sides of 再.|再见~goodbye~回家前，我们向朋友说再见。~Before going home, we say goodbye to our friends.|再次~again; once more~我再次试着把纸船折好。~I try folding the paper boat once more.
见|jian4|see|Notice the two lower strokes spreading below the box-like top of 见.|看见~see~我们看见一只小鸟停在树上。~We see a bird sitting in the tree.|见面~meet~周末，我们在公园见面。~At the weekend, we meet in the park.
好|hao3|good; well|Find 女 beside 子 in 好.|好看~good-looking; nice to look at~这张彩色地图很好看。~This colourful map looks lovely.|友好~friendly~我们友好地和新朋友打招呼。~We greet our new friend in a friendly way.

朋|peng2|friend|Compare the two 月 shapes side by side in 朋.|朋友~friend~我给朋友写了一张卡片。~I write a card to my friend.|亲朋~relatives and friends~节日里，亲朋一起吃饭。~During the festival, relatives and friends eat together.
友|you3|friend|Find 又 below the top strokes of 友.|好友~good friend~好友陪我一起看书。~My good friend reads with me.|友好~friendly~故事里的小动物相处得很友好。~The little animals in the story get along well.
同|tong2|same; together|Notice 口 inside the outer frame of 同.|同学~classmate~同学们一起打扫教室。~The classmates clean the classroom together.|相同~the same~这两块积木的颜色相同。~These two blocks have the same colour.
老|lao3|old; experienced|Notice the slanting stroke crossing above 匕 in 老.|老师~teacher~老师给我们讲了一个故事。~The teacher tells us a story.|老人~older person~我们在车上给老人让座。~We offer an older person a seat on the bus.

少|shao3|few; little|Notice the long slanting stroke beneath the small upper strokes of 少.|多少~how many; how much~篮子里有多少个苹果？~How many apples are in the basket?|很少~very few; rarely~冬天，花园里开的花很少。~Very few flowers bloom in the garden in winter.
孩|hai2|child|Find 子 on the left of 孩.|孩子~child~孩子们在院子里画画。~The children draw in the yard.|小孩~young child~小孩和大人一起过桥。~The young child crosses the bridge with an adult.
童|tong2|child|Find 立 above 里 in 童.|儿童~children~这本故事书适合儿童阅读。~This storybook is suitable for children to read.|童话~fairy tale~奶奶给我讲了一个童话。~Grandma tells me a fairy tale.
男|nan2|male; boy|Find 田 above 力 in 男.|男孩~boy~男孩把小球还给了朋友。~The boy returns the little ball to his friend.|男生~male student~男生和女生一起搭积木。~The boys and girls build with blocks together.

女|nv3|female; girl|Notice the long horizontal stroke crossing the bent strokes of 女.|女孩~girl~女孩在本子上画了一棵树。~The girl draws a tree in her notebook.|女生~female student~女生们一起整理书架。~The girls arrange the bookshelf together.
性|xing4|nature; character; attribute|Find 忄 beside 生 in 性.|性格~personality~每个人的性格都不一样。~Everyone has a different personality.|耐性~patience~折这个小盒子需要耐性。~Folding this little box takes patience.

先|xian1|first; before|Notice the two spreading lower strokes of 先.|首先~first of all~首先，我们把纸放平。~First, we flatten the paper.|先后~one after another~小朋友们先后走进教室。~The children enter the classroom one after another.
后|hou4|after; behind|Find 口 below the upper slanting strokes of 后.|以后~after; later~吃饭以后，我们去散步。~After eating, we go for a walk.|后面~behind; at the back~书架后面有一扇窗。~There is a window behind the bookshelf.

左|zuo3|left|Find 工 beneath the upper strokes of 左.|左边~left side~左边的盒子装着彩笔。~The box on the left holds coloured pens.|左右~left and right; about~过路口时，我们和大人一起看左右。~At the crossing, we look left and right with an adult.

中|zhong1|middle; centre|Notice the upright stroke passing through 口 in 中.|中间~middle~桌子中间放着一篮水果。~A basket of fruit is in the middle of the table.|中心~centre~圆的中心有一个小点。~There is a small dot at the centre of the circle.
里|li3|inside|Notice 田 above the broad lower strokes of 里.|里面~inside~盒子里面有一只纸船。~There is a paper boat inside the box.|这里~here~这里有一块空地，可以画画。~There is a clear space here where we can draw.
外|wai4|outside|Find 夕 beside 卜 in 外.|外面~outside~外面的花开了。~The flowers outside have bloomed.|户外~outdoors~天气好的时候，我们去户外活动。~When the weather is good, we do activities outdoors.

前|qian2|front; before|Notice the narrow 刂 on the right of 前.|前面~in front~前面的路很平，我们慢慢走。~The path ahead is flat; we walk slowly.|以前~before; previously~以前，这里有一座小木桥。~There used to be a little wooden bridge here.
北|bei3|north|Compare the two halves facing apart in 北.|北方~the north~地图上方标着北方。~North is marked at the top of the map.|北风~north wind~北风吹来，我们戴上帽子。~A north wind blows; we put on our hats.
南|nan2|south|Notice the outer frame and short upper upright of 南.|南方~the south~冬天，有些鸟会飞向南方。~In winter, some birds fly south.|南瓜~pumpkin~@basket

东|dong1|east|Notice the small spreading bottom strokes of 东.|东方~the east~早晨，太阳从东方升起。~In the morning, the sun rises in the east.|东边~east side~公园的东边有一条小河。~There is a little river on the east side of the park.
西|xi1|west|Notice the two inner strokes inside the frame of 西.|西方~the west~傍晚，太阳在西方慢慢落下。~In the evening, the sun slowly sets in the west.|西瓜~watermelon~@meal
高|gao1|high; tall|Notice the small upper 口 and larger lower frame of 高.|高大~tall and big~这棵树很高大。~This tree is tall and large.|高兴~happy~收到朋友的信，我很高兴。~I am happy to receive my friend's letter.
低|di1|low|Find 亻 beside 氐 in 低; notice its bottom dot.|低头~lower one's head~我低头看地上的小花。~I lower my head to look at the little flowers.|低声~in a low voice~图书馆里，我们低声说话。~In the library, we speak quietly.

长|chang2|long; length|Follow the long bent lower stroke of 长; these words use cháng.|长度~length~我们用尺子量绳子的长度。~We use a ruler to measure the string's length.|长短~length; long and short~我们把长短不同的绳子分开放。~We separate the strings of different lengths.
